exposure: second trimester transvaginal ultrasound cervical length (CL)
cohort: Nulliparous singleton women 18 0/7-23 6/7 weeks gestation who underwent cervical length screening and reached term with a planned vaginal delivery.
finding: A longer second trimester cervical length (CL >= 37 mm) was associated with a two-fold increased risk for prolonged pregnancy, though cervical length was not found to be predictive.
gest_age: 18 0/7-23 6/7 weeks (for screening), >=37 weeks (term), >=41 0/7 weeks (for outcome definition)
